newsitem.title: USA: American Express in card deal with Bradesco.
newsitem.headline: American Express in card deal with Bradesco.

text.p: American Express and Bradesco, Brazil's largest private bank, said on Thursday that Bradesco agreed to sell American Express cards through its branch network.
Over the past two years, American Express said it has concluded agreements with several financial institutions worldwide to issue and sell American Express Cards.

Overseas banks issuing American Express cards include Israel's Bank Hapoalim, Banco Comercial Portugues (Portugal), Alpha Credit Bank in Greece, Turkey's Akbank, Tong Yang Card Corp (South Korea), and Banco Consolidado (Venezuela).
